name: Glacier & Waterton Lakes
about: The Going-to-the-Sun Road usually isn't fully open until late June and closes again by mid-October, making summer the only real window for most of the park.
overview: Jointly designated as one Peace Park straddling the US-Canada border — glacier-carved peaks, alpine lakes, and the Going-to-the-Sun Road.
costOverview: Prices stay close to typical national-park levels on both sides of the border — the one real outlier is Glacier's non-US-resident surcharge, a flat fee that catches many international visitors off guard.

specialSeasons.text: This is the only reliable window when the Going-to-the-Sun Road is fully open end to end — outside it, snow closes most of the park's high country.
